title: Thigh-High Slit Satin Sleeveless Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This satin bridesmaid dress has a sleek, feminine look with its soft cowl neckline and smooth, body-skimming silhouette. Gentle draping through the skirt adds a flattering touch, while the side slit brings movement and a longer leg line. A beautiful choice for bridal parties, formal weddings, and elegant evening celebrations.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
